notes.title: Update-Workshop integration for the Circuits Composer
notes.content:
We have made an update to our Circuits Composer,

now everyone can upload their own songs to the workshop and also their own sounds to being used into de composer. And also everyone can download the others sounds and songs to use it on the composer.

here we created a little guide to help you understanding how to use this new feature : 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=496294079


Please if you have any question let us know. 

Now you can go to the workshop tab on the circuits community hub and suscribe to the items you want. They will automatically download and will be ready to use in the next composer launch.

Regards,
Digital Tentacle.

notes.title: update and Soundtrack for you all
notes.content:
We have been updated the game. this update include the next fixes :

-Level 23 must have it´s layers sounding with their respective sounds
-Level 18 have been redesigned for a clear understanding
-Fixed a major bug that don´t let a few player under some situations play past level 6
-Fixed non localized text in fail level window.

We have been upload the full soundtrack and a bonus track for you all. You can find the soundtrack into the circuits directory in the OST folder.

Again, thank you all for the support.


( oh, we will be gifting an special track for you all )
